defects.claim: Feature validation accepts an embedded U+0000, so HarfBuzz parses a truncated feature string and shape applies it instead of rejecting it, caching under the full string
defects.scenario: feature string like 'liga\u0000junk' passes validation; HarfBuzz reads only 'liga', the feature is applied, and the cache key is the full string
defects.cause: ASCII check admits NUL; Feature.fromString passes a NUL-terminated buffer
